panels.title: Awaiting Retry
panels.description: Messages waiting out their retry TTL before the worker sees them again.

panels.title: Dead-Lettered
panels.description: Messages that exhausted their retries. Nothing drains these on its own.

panels.title: Consumers
panels.description: One per running worker. A drop to zero means the queue has nobody reading it.

panels.title: Unacked Messages By Queue
panels.description: Delivered and still being worked on. A flat non-zero line is a stuck consumer.

panels.title: Event Loop Lag
panels.description: This process renders React server-side, so a blocked loop shows up as slow documents long before it shows up as an error.

panels.title: Scrape Health
panels.description: The scrape also runs three indexed counts against Postgres for the pipeline gauges, so its duration is worth watching.

panels.title: Warnings And Errors
panels.description: Pino writes levels as numbers, and promtail keeps them verbatim: 40 warn, 50 error, 60 fatal.
